title: Kitchen Plumbing Checklist Before Modular Kitchen Installation
metaTitle: Kitchen Plumbing Checklist Before Modular Kitchen Installation
description: Use this kitchen plumbing checklist before modular kitchen installation. Check water lines, drainage, sink points, and leaks to avoid rework.

(A Complete Homeowner’s Guide)

Installing a modular kitchen is a big investment—and once cabinets, shutters, and countertops are fixed, plumbing mistakes become expensive and messy to fix. That’s why kitchen plumbing must be planned and executed before modular kitchen installation.

This detailed checklist will help homeowners, interior designers, and contractors ensure leak-free, efficient, and future-ready kitchen plumbing, while also choosing the right faucets, sinks, and Pipes & fittings at Prayag, the leading sanitaryware manufacturer in India.

Why Plumbing Planning Is Critical Before Modular Kitchen Installation

Most plumbing lines run behind cabinets and below countertops. Any error—wrong pipe placement, poor-quality fittings, or incorrect faucet choice—can lead to:

  • Water leakage inside cabinets

  • Swollen wood & damaged modular units

  • Foul smells from poor drainage

  • Costly dismantling later

A proper checklist ensures:
✔ Long-term durability
✔ Smooth installation
✔ Hassle-free maintenance
✔ Better water efficiency

1. Water Inlet Planning Checklist

Before cabinets arrive, confirm these points:

  • ✅ Hot & cold water lines clearly marked

  • ✅ Inlet points positioned below sink cabinet

  • ✅ Separate stop valves for hot & cold water

  • ✅ Easy access to valves (not hidden behind drawers)

  • ✅ Adequate water pressure tested

Pro Tip:
Always install individual angle valves for sink and dishwasher—this allows repairs without shutting off the entire house supply.

2. Kitchen Sink Selection Checklist

Your sink choice impacts plumbing layout, cabinet size, and faucet selection.

Things to Check:

  • ✅ Sink type: Single bowl / Double bowl / With drainboard

  • ✅ Sink material: Stainless steel preferred for durability

  • ✅ Sink depth (minimum 8–9 inches for Indian kitchens)

  • ✅ Undermount or top-mount (confirm with countertop vendor)

  • ✅ Drain hole alignment with waste pipe

Recommended Brand:

Prayag Kitchen Sinks are known for:

  • High-grade stainless steel

  • Deep bowl designs for Indian cooking

  • Easy maintenance & long lifespan

3. Kitchen Faucet Checklist (Most Ignored, Most Important)

A kitchen faucet is used more than any other fixture in the house.

Before Finalising a Faucet, Check:

  • ✅ Swivel spout (360° rotation)

  • ✅ Single-lever control for easy temperature adjustment

  • ✅ Aerator for water saving & splash control

  • ✅ Compatible height with sink & window shutters

  • ✅ Strong internal cartridge (ceramic preferred)

Why Prayag is the Best Choice for Kitchen Faucets

Prayag kitchen faucets stand out because they offer:

  • Smooth single-lever operation

  • Durable brass construction

  • Water-saving aerators

  • Elegant designs that match modular kitchens

  • Reliable performance for Indian water conditions

Result: Long life, better flow, and fewer complaints.

4. Drainage & Waste Pipe Checklist

Poor drainage is the #1 cause of kitchen plumbing issues.

Must-Check Points:

  • ✅ Waste pipe diameter minimum 40 mm

  • ✅ Proper slope for smooth water flow

  • ✅ Bottle trap or P-trap installed

  • ✅ No sharp bends in drainage line

  • ✅ Easy access for cleaning blockages

Avoid:
Flexible corrugated pipes—they clog faster with oil & food waste.

5. Dishwasher & RO Provision Checklist (If Applicable)

If you plan appliances, prepare plumbing in advance.

Dishwasher:

  • ✅ Dedicated water inlet point

  • ✅ Separate drain connection

  • ✅ Power socket above cabinet base

RO / Water Purifier:

  • ✅ Inlet tap with T-joint

  • ✅ Drain saddle connection

  • ✅ Space allocated inside sink cabinet

Planning this early avoids drilling and pipe cutting later.

6. Pipe & Fittings Quality Checklist

Hidden plumbing should always be premium-grade.

Best Practices:

  • ✅ Use CPVC / PPR pipes for durability

  • ✅ Branded fittings only

  • ✅ Pressure testing before cabinet installation

  • ✅ Leak test for at least 24 hours

Remember:
Cabinets can be replaced. Pipes cannot—choose quality first.

7. Kitchen Cabinet Protection Checklist

Plumbing safety inside cabinets is often overlooked.

  • ✅ Waterproof laminate or PVC base inside sink cabinet

  • ✅ Aluminium or PVC bottom panel under sink

  • ✅ Drip tray below trap (optional but useful)

  • ✅ Silicone sealing around pipe cut-outs

This prevents long-term damage due to unnoticed drips.

8. Ventilation & Odour Control Checklist

  • ✅ Proper trap seal to block foul smells

  • ✅ No open drain connections

  • ✅ Regular access for cleaning

Good plumbing = no kitchen odour issues.

9. Final Pre-Installation Plumbing Checklist

Before modular kitchen installation begins, ensure:

  • ✔ All inlets & outlets are tested

  • ✔ No visible leakage

  • ✔ Sink & faucet trial-fitted

  • ✔ Drain flow checked with full water load

  • ✔ Appliance provisions confirmed

Only after this should cabinets and shutters be installed.

Why Choosing the Right Brand Matters

When it comes to kitchen plumbing fixtures, quality directly affects daily comfort. Brands like Prayag are trusted because they offer:

  • Consistent water flow

  • Durable materials

  • Modern designs

  • Compatibility with modular kitchens

  • Long-term reliability

Whether it’s kitchen faucets or sinks, investing in a reliable brand reduces maintenance and ensures peace of mind.

Conclusion

A modular kitchen looks beautiful—but only good plumbing makes it functional for years. By following this kitchen plumbing checklist before installation, you avoid hidden issues, protect your cabinets, and ensure smooth everyday usage.

Plan smart. Choose quality fixtures. And always finalise plumbing before your modular kitchen goes in.
